testcase.name: [sig-node] Pods Extended Pod Container lifecycle evicted pods should be terminal
[sig-cli] Kubectl client Kubectl apply apply set/view last-applied
[sig-node] [DRA] control plane with different ResourceSlices keeps pod pending because of CEL runtime errors
[sig-api-machinery] ResourceQuota should create a ResourceQuota and capture the life of a persistent volume claim with a storage class
[sig-node] InitContainer [NodeConformance] should invoke init containers on a RestartNever pod [Conformance]
[sig-node] Kubelet with pods in a privileged namespace when scheduling an agnhost Pod with hostAliases and hostNetwork should write entries to /etc/hosts when hostNetwork is enabled [NodeConformance]
[sig-api-machinery] AdmissionWebhook [Privileged:ClusterAdmin] should be able to deny attaching pod [Conformance]
[sig-apps] StatefulSet Basic StatefulSet functionality [StatefulSetBasic] should have a working scale subresource [Conformance]
[sig-node] Probing container should be ready immediately after startupProbe succeeds
[sig-node] [DRA] kubelet [Feature:DynamicResourceAllocation] [FeatureGate:DRAPrioritizedList] [Beta] selects the first subrequest that can be satisfied
[sig-cli] Kubectl rollout undo undo should rollback and update deployment env
[sig-api-machinery] Garbage collector should delete jobs and pods created by cronjob
[sig-node] Pod InPlace Resize Container burstable pods - 1 container with all requests & limits set and resize policy cpu restart resizing cpu requests
[sig-node] [NodeConformance] [FeatureGate:SidecarContainers] Probing restartable init container should *not* be restarted with a non-local redirect http liveness probe

[sig-apps] DisruptionController evictions: no PDB => should allow an eviction

[sig-node] [NodeConformance] [FeatureGate:SidecarContainers] Probing restartable init container should be restarted startup probe fails

[sig-node] [NodeConformance] [FeatureGate:SidecarContainers] Probing restartable init container should not be ready with an exec readiness probe timeout

[Jira:openshift-apiserver][sig-api-machinery] sanity test should always pass [Suite:openshift/cluster-openshift-apiserver-operator/conformance/parallel]

[sig-auth][Feature:RoleBindingRestrictions] RoleBindingRestrictions should be functional Rolebinding restrictions tests single project should succeed [apigroup:authorization.openshift.io] [Suite:openshift/conformance/parallel]
[Jira:"Cluster Version Operator"] cluster-version-operator-tests can use oc to get the version information
[sig-cli] Workloads client test ROSA-OSD_CCS-ARO-ConnectedOnly-Author:yinzhou-Critical-11882-Return description of resources with cli describe
